system.longDesc: You are the shield that protects your friends.

degree0.desc: Your desire to protect others lends you speed. When you perform the Bodyguard action stunt, you can move up to 6 meters instead of 3.

degree1.desc: You react quickly to put yourself in harm’s way. When you perform the Guardian Angel action stunt, the amount of damage you take instead of your ally is equal to the number of SP spent +2.

degree2.desc: You become the shadow of those who would hurt others. If you are standing next to an opponent and that opponent moves within 2 meters of one of your allies, you can move adjacent to the opponent before they finish their turn, even if it would surpass your Speed. Your Speed is 0 on your next turn.
